name: 999,Victory
source:
One day, the protagonist is suddenly chosen to be the Demon Lord’s bride.
If she can’t escape, then she has no choice but to defeat him!
With only 24 hours until the wedding, take advantage of the Demon Lord’s absence, conquer the castle, and prepare to face him!
translation:
有一天，主角突然被选为魔王的新娘。
如果逃不掉，那她就只有打败他了！
距离婚礼只剩下24小时了，趁魔王不在的时候，攻克城堡，准备迎战他吧！
